messages.author: 5998661b9f5e4691
messages.subject: DT: Update global search
parts:
Hello,

Is it possible to update the global search term for a datatable? 

There are functions to select or add rows and columns (https://yihui.shinyapps.io/DT-proxy/), but I could not find a way to update the search field.

Best,
Florian

messages.author: 5998661b9f5e4691
messages.subject: Re: DT: Update global search
parts:
I tried 

input$datatable_search <- new_search_term

but that value is read-only.

On Sunday, April 3, 2016 at 8:28:41 PM UTC-4, Florian Breitwieser wrote:
Hello,

Is it possible to update the global search term for a datatable? 

There are functions to select or add rows and columns (https://yihui.shinyapps.io/DT-proxy/), but I could not find a way to update the search field.

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: DT: Update global search
parts:
With the development version

devtools::install_github('rstudio/DT')

you can use updateSearch() to change the search keyword, e.g.

# create proxy with dataTableProxy()
observe({
proxy %>% updateSearch(list(global = new_search_term))
})


Regards,
Yihui
